106: async function compareReference(actualPath) {
107:   const actual = PNG.sync.read(fs.readFileSync(actualPath))
108:   const reference = PNG.sync.read(fs.readFileSync(REFERENCE))
109:   if (actual.width !== reference.width || actual.height !== reference.height) {
110:     return { match: false, similarity: 0, reason: `size ${actual.width}x${actual.height} vs ${reference.width}x${reference.height}` }
111:   }
112:   const diff = new PNG({ width: actual.width, height: actual.height })
113:   const mismatched = pixelmatch(actual.data, reference.data, diff.data, actual.width, actual.height, {
114:     threshold: 0.1,
115:     includeAA: false
116:   })
117:   fs.writeFileSync(DIFF, PNG.sync.write(diff))
118:   const total = actual.width * actual.height
119:   const similarity = 1 - mismatched / total
120:   return { match: similarity >= 0.995, similarity, mismatched, total }
